verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.fireworks.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) and markdown versions of the doc pages. Each .md page points agents back to the llms.txt index, and llms.txt also lists the OpenAPI specs, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: no independent or community corroboration of agents actually using these docs, and no llms-full.txt or similar full-content bundle is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.fireworks.ai/llms.txt # Fireworks AI Docs
Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.fireworks.ai/llms.txt
